Name: Perfect Fruit
Author: TheAppleSauceIsStale
Description:

[center][img]https://imgur.com/U9iM75i.png[/img]﻿

﻿[img]https://imgur.com/bmFPAZZ.png[/img]﻿
﻿﻿[color=#ffffff][size=3]❧[/size][/color]
[size=3]Fruit trees now have a chance to surprise you with "Perfect" variations of their normal produce. On top of their special look, these fruit are [b]five times[/b] as valuable as their regular counterparts, provide [b]five times[/b] the nutritional value, and can be turned into artisan goods just like any other fruit.[/size][/center]

[center][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/ITkhL29.png[/img]﻿﻿
﻿﻿﻿❧
﻿If you collect enough Perfect Fruit, you can trade them in for their respective Perfect Saplings at the Casino! While selling for no profit as-is, these special saplings exclusively grow Perfect Fruit.[/size][/center]


[center][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/JwE4O4V.png[/img]﻿[/size][/center]
[size=3]
Easily tweak how challenging it is to obtain Perfect Fruit, their look, and the "mode" of price balancing with several options. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is recommended![/size]

[spoiler]❧ ❧ ❧ [size=3]

[b][color=#e69138]Chance For Perfect Fruit[/color] [/b](Default 0.09): A number between 1 and 0 that determines how likely it is for a Perfect variant to spawn at the start of a day instead of normal fruit -- 1 is always, and 0 is never.

[b][color=#e69138]Fruit Needed For Saplings[/color][/b] (Default 3): The number of fruit the Casino demands for a Perfect Sapling. 

[b][color=#e69138]Unlock Condition[/color] [/b](Default None): For more immersion, you can choose between three progressively more challenging requirements that must be met before Perfect Fruit appear on normal fruit trees ([/size][size=3]Changing this config at the title screen rather than in-save is recommended):

[color=#e69138]After Community Center Completion[/color]: View the event where you acquire the Stardew Hero Trophy.
[color=#e69138]After Perfect Grandpa Evaluation[/color]: Have all 4 candles lit (aka at least 12 points) at Grandpa's Shrine.
[color=#e69138]After Perfection[/color]: Reach Perfection!

[b][color=#e69138]SVBO Balancing[/color] [/b][/size][size=3](Default False): For those who use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13426]Stardew Valley Balance Overhaul[/url], this toggle changes the price of Perfect Fruit to be five times the rebalanced fruit prices instead of vanilla's.

[b][color=#e69138]Exclude From Perfection [/color][/b](Default True): Decide if shipping Perfect Fruit should count towards Perfection.[/size]

﻿❧ ﻿❧ ﻿[size=3]❧ [/size][/spoiler]
[center][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/2X7GANp.png[/img]﻿[/size][/center]
﻿[size=6]⚠ [/size][size=3][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7098?tab=posts]Ui Info Suite 2[/url]﻿ - The console will display red errors with content depending on what "Unlock Condition" is set to.[/b] This may stem from an issue parsing/displaying Game State Queries in the "Condition" field for fruit trees, and I haven't found a definitive way to fix them while keeping the config options functional yet. These errors don't noticeably impact performance or cause other issues within itself or my mod when I tested for them, but they might appear frequently at the start of each day. [/size]

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43127?tab=posts]Ui Info Suite 2 Alternative[/url] - No known errors! I recommend using this version instead.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url] - A [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39577]Cometkins-style retexture/replacer[/url] has been made by Sugarmaples (thank you!)

[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21284]﻿Vanilla Tweaks[/url][/b] - This mod has a dedicated config option to switch between Vanilla-style and Vanilla-Tweaks-style Perfect Fruit and Saplings (Thank you again to Taiyo for allowing me to use/recolor your sprites!)[/size]

[size=3][size=3][color=#e69138][b]Other Mods With Custom Fruit Trees ( Growable Forage, Cornucopia, SVE, VMV, [/b][/color][color=#e69138][b]etc. )[/b] [/color]- I do plan on making add-ons of Perfect Fruit for popular mods (or mods I just personally like), but they will likely release quite slowly, and depend partly on if I acquire permission to edit the fruit and sapling sprites found in these mods (and their Vanilla-Tweaks-style variants, if they exist!) Links to them will be posted on this page if and when they release.[/size]
